<!-- wg-report cycle=2026-11-02 group=wg:third-party-ready -->
Paused: 2 reports unacknowledged. Receive in a session or react 👍 to resume.

WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-01 11:30 to 2026-11-02 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: no new escalations; the same three drafts are still unanswered (3 days).
- 21b6b4b7 (srs#236, P0): field identity and naming rules are in the spec but nothing enforces them. Options: enforce in the schema, enforce in a validator, or stop claiming them. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium (the P0 cannot move).
- 864eaebf (srs#991): one heading-outline rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition (Door 3, amends an Accepted RFC). Action needed: decide. Urgency: low (draft only).
- c7a8e0a2 (srs-rust#1497, already merged): may `note delete` refuse notes that Relations point at? Ratification only.
Also: needs-input on srs-rust#1491, #683, srs#928.

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified. No group PR merged, so no decision was ready and no session was held.

3. Done: no group PRs merged this cycle (the group is paused). Last group merge: srs-rust#1539 on 2026-10-30.

4. Stuck or lost: 5 group-labelled PRs open, none moved this cycle.
- srs#991: waits on you (see 1).
- srs-rust#1540 and #1541: reviewer rejected on red CI; both behind master. They need the builder, who is paused.
- srs-rust#1535: owner-merge, clean, no quorum line.
- srs-rust#1487: reviewer rejected, merge state dirty, untouched since 10-28.
- srs-programme#382 (finding): open.

5. Budget: 0 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 4 open per group-state. Pause state: paused: 2 reports unacknowledged.
5b. Awaiting ratification: 8487fd7a (arrangement fixture allowlist, proposed, 6 days); c7a8e0a2, 864eaebf, 21b6b4b7 (drafts, above). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready + wg:third-party-ready in srs-rust, srs, srs-vscode, srs-web: 14 open issues (srs-rust 11, srs 2, srs-web 1, srs-vscode 0). No local priorities set. Queue is fed (about 1 cycle of work once running), but the pause, not the queue, is the constraint. Waits on you: the three decisions in 1, the ratification in 5b, and the acknowledgement that resumes the group. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-31 12:19 (filed 5, conformance sweep); no run since.
6b. Exercises: dd1a47a7 "Relation reads hide who asserted a link"; 2ac083c0 "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable"; 7131fe89 "Substrate entries: spec contract and schemas disagree". All the group's own, none listed in the SemanticOps log. Build trigger: logs hold well over 10 ratified decisions, so srs-web#560 is still ready to unpark; your call.

7. What we learned: third paused cycle in a row; nothing moves without the acknowledgement, and the rejected PRs need a builder to move. Measurement c19cc6d6 (I1): window opened at this close, so it reads 0 of 1 grounded to a problem (one PR merged elsewhere after 11:30, not a group delivery). A close-time read is always near empty. Useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
